title: loranthus macrantherus

It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in treating various conditions such as fever and skin infections. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
